name: Misfit Agent Evaluation Lab External Benchmark Run Manifest
purpose: Give an independent evaluator one bounded, reproducible handoff for running external agent-safety benchmarks against the public Agent Evaluation Lab without receiving protected GHOSBC internals.

supported_profiles.required_pin: stable public benchmark reference plus exact version or commit supplied by evaluator
stable public benchmark reference plus exact version or commit supplied by evaluator

run_protocol: Pin the benchmark, evaluator harness, runtime, model/agent version and environment before execution.
Target only the published API/A2A surface; do not request or infer private GHOSBC kernel material.
Preserve benchmark-native prompts, outputs, aggregate metrics and evaluator logs where licensing permits.
Record run_id, UTC start/end timestamps, seed/determinism notes and all material configuration values.
Hash durable artifacts with SHA-256 when practical.
Return an evidence receipt conforming to the published external benchmark evidence schema.
Set externally_validated=true only when the independent run actually occurred and the referenced artifact supports that statement.

prohibited: private GHOSBC kernel source or prompts
Mother Language / Soul Cipher / GHX / glyph internals
